setEffects.4: The equipping character gains 1 Starspark when they use an Elemental Skill, Elemental Burst, or perform a Normal Attack. Up to 2 Starsparks can be held at once. The equipping character gains Undying Radiance while holding at least 1 Starspark. This effect increases the CRIT Rate of their Cryo DMG by 20%, with an additional 20% CRIT Rate if that DMG is Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG. The equipping character loses 1 Starspark every 3s while on the field. Undying Radiance ends when all Starsparks are extinguished.

flower.name: Flower of the Epochal Advent
flower.desc: The high heavens bestowed an everlasting flower on their envoy, and greed was born of a life without end.

plume.name: Plume of the Epochal Advent
plume.desc: The high heavens bestowed a feather of rebirth on their envoy, with all sin to be forgiven where even fate meets its very end.

sands.name: Sands of the Epochal Advent
sands.desc: The high heavens bestowed a sundial of counter-time on their envoy, and an inviolable interdiction became a wellspring of rage.

goblet.name: Goblet of the Epochal Advent
goblet.desc: The high heavens bestowed sweet nectar on their envoy, and the unending feast opened wide the doors to desire.

circlet.name: Circlet of the Epochal Advent
circlet.desc: The high heavens bestowed a splendid crown on their envoy, and arrogance was born out of power unchecked.
